title: Single-Use-Runtime-Refresh nach Terminal-Run-Closeout-Task
goal: Genau einen kontrollierten immutable Bureau-Runtime-Refresh auf den unmittelbar vor Ausführung frisch beobachteten, reviewten und CI-grünen current main autorisieren, der PR #1941 / Merge-Commit 2d4f9f6ec8fb9d414c2a5655fa6d990f33e2ef82 enthält. Zweck ist ausschließlich, BUREAU-CONTROL-PLANE-V3-FU-HISTORICAL-CLOSEOUT-TERMINAL-RUN-20260813 über den normalen koordinierten Pickup claimbar zu machen.

approval.note: Single-use only. Fresh main/PR #1941/required-check/StateStore/target/live-lease evidence before prepare/apply; immutable readback, lease release and closeout-authority after success. No historical refresh replay, runtime rollback, Grabowski runtime, Queue, claim or dispatch effect.

acceptance.assertion: TaskSpec is merged through protected PR and selectively seeded if missing. Immediately before execution current main includes PR #1941 / 2d4f9f6ec8fb9d414c2a5655fa6d990f33e2ef82, required checks are green and target_sha256 is fresh.
Before prepare and apply the exact authoritative TaskSpec is ready/active, positive revision/digest, single-use-target-bound and has no prior target binding, consumption or runtime_closeout.

Apply uses only exact intent-bound live leases. Exactly one effect_started=true deploy is allowed; manifest, immutable release, package tree, launchers, Registry snapshot, bureau check and StateStore integrity agree on the target commit.

After successful immutable readback the runtime leases are released and closeout-authority terminalizes this exact task with matching target/intent/result. No second effect or unrelated state mutation occurs.

rollback.strategy: On ambiguous/failed apply do not retry blindly; preserve last valid immutable runtime and reconcile only from target/result/receipt/StateStore evidence.

publication_path.reason: Installed immutable runtime predates the just-merged TaskSpec and normal pickup failed pre-effect with release-registry-identity-mismatch.
